stem: What happens next in this passage after “A consumer class discussed the trade-off.”?
options: He also printed a small paper note with her seat number.
Saving seeds was also saving choices for tomorrow's meals.
It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.
Saving paper was good, but personal data also had value.
